description: Not a lever of the fused stack: the K-split of the chunked prefill SDPA for the tail passes (QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF_KSPLIT, gate only, default off, a NUMERICS change). A tail pass of 1,024 or 512 rows keeps 48 or 24 of the grid's 130 cores busy under the oneq call and a q chunk's K stream is serial on its core; flag 0x10 of the SDPA program word gives each q chunk up to four slices on idle cores and folds their partial results with the pinned ring merge, in slice order. The output differs from the oneq call in the last bits: the waiver card is in docs/tp4-prefill3-ksplit.md and a traffic profile carrying the flag is refused by serving_c2_contract.ksplit_problems unless the owner's traffic waiver names it. Its three gate-only twins (-pf3k-s5-ctl, -pf3k-s5 and -pf3k-s5-audit of the ship-5 candidate) are generated by make_pf3k_profiles.py. Unset (the default) nothing moves: tp_addresses does not even import the module. Needs the K64j-OQ-KS graft (optimisation/ttnn-op/sdpa_prefill_ksplit/build_k64j_oq_ks.sh), which has never been built.

smoke.what: PF3-K K-split of the tail passes' attention

image_files.reason: tp_addresses.install imports it when QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF_KSPLIT or its audit flag is SET (the wrapper that ORs the K-split bit into the oneq program word); an image without it refuses that boot
sdpa_pf_ksplit_tp imports it in the audit (the error statistic and the provisional bound of the numerics waiver)

card_jobs: none yet: the card-M harness and runner are optimisation/ttnn-op/sdpa_prefill_ksplit/ksplit_card_m.py and run_card_m_ks.sh (templates); the four-card pair is described in docs/tp4-prefill3-ksplit.md section 5
notes: Shared files this package edits: serving_c2_contract.py (ksplit_problems, the waivable table, one call in boot), tp_addresses.py (one block after the oneq one), profile_twins.py and the census tests that exempt generated twins, test_serving_image_copy_closure.py and test_tp4_closure_literals.py (the new overlay-only module).
